items.source: Adapter implementation of the ResultSetExtractor interface that delegates to a RowMapper which is supposed to create an object for each row. Each object is added to the results List of this ResultSetExtractor.
items.translation: 这是 `ResultSetExtractor` 接口的适配器实现，它委托给一个 `RowMapper`（该映射器应为每一行创建一个对象）。每个创建的对象都会被添加到此 `ResultSetExtractor` 的结果列表中。
